title: The Team screen
subtitle: Who is doing what this week

scenes.say: [open]This is the Team screen, under Team in the left nav. It shows everyone on Riverside Design, and how many tasks they have taken on this week.
[list]This is the "Who is doing what" list. Each row is one person, with their initials, name and role, so you know who does what at a glance.

[row]Next to each person is a bar showing how many tasks they have taken on this week, against how many they said they can take. [amara]Watch Amara's row fill in. She has taken on five tasks but only said she can manage four, so her bar turns red and flags her as over capacity.
[jonas]Jonas Berg has no tasks assigned right now, because he is away. [away]His row shows exactly when he is due back, so you know not to add work until then.
